brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.evidence: 3-cell cluster with bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 provide 2 compartments each (4 small compartments for buttons, needles, bobbins etc), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full provides large open tray for fabric/scissors. Caps and joint bolts fitted.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell organizer: two divided bins give four small compartments for notions, one full bin for larger tools/fabric. Configurator BUSY prevented prop staging; shape provides tidy storage as requested.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
